title: Furnace-temperature testing and loaded acceptance checks for a titanium-alloy thick-plate roller-hearth furnace
summary: A 2020 Suneng roller-hearth furnace technical draft specifies furnace-temperature uniformity alongside a loaded test using seven thick titanium-alloy plates and sixteen test thermocouples, with data collected four hours after loading. Assess the measurement objects and limits separately. A material-temperature criterion at one cross-section is not whole-furnace uniformity.
